subject.title: feat(cua): add experimental read-only diagnostics provider

question: Should Crabbox ship CUA now as an experimental read-only service-control provider while delegated execution remains blocked on upstream ownership primitives?
rationale: The branch no longer implements the original delegated-run request; it introduces a narrower built-in provider and configuration contract whose product value and long-term support require maintainer intent.

options.title: Ship diagnostics-only CUA
options.body: Accept doctor, list, and status after correcting the documentation and proving credentialed read-only behavior.

options.title: Wait for delegated execution
options.body: Defer the built-in integration until upstream ownership primitives support the original provider workflow safely.

recommendation.title: Ship diagnostics-only CUA
recommendation.body: Accept doctor, list, and status after correcting the documentation and proving credentialed read-only behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They carried the current rework and are the strongest available owner for its diagnostics-only boundary.
